purpose: Primary Offset Loop: a coral run (about 274 deg) that ends in a crisp cut, then a periwinkle run that continues one lane inward across the break and laps the loop start. The lane step is the deliberate interruption.
animationTargets: a01-outer then a01-inner: stroke-dashoffset draw, pathLength=100 (GSAP, scene-owned)
notes: REV 4. Stroke-only, butt caps, pathLength=100, ids a01-outer then a01-inner. Radius carries a 4 percent organic modulation shared by both lanes. Stroke widths 12 and 9 for 48 px legibility.

purpose: Open-variant Offset Loop: one lopsided organic contour (asymmetric bump+pinch, not an ellipse) traced mostly in coral (~232deg) with an explicit 20deg gap, then a short periwinkle accent (~92deg) continuing from the gap and ending in open negative space -- a single interrupted gesture, not a second concentric loop.
animationTargets: a02-outer then a02-inner: stroke-dashoffset draw, pathLength=100 (GSAP, scene-owned)
notes: REV5-correction-1. Rebuilt from REV4's two-concentric-circle / single-coral-color construction. Two intermediate constructions (off-center ellipse lane, same-ellipse inward lane) were rendered and rejected for still reading as nested loops before this one shipped. Not independently/owner-reviewed.

purpose: Cropped, partial signature contour for editorial framing with generous negative space.
animationTargets: none required; may be masked by a parent clip
notes: Only the arc is drawn; the ends are open so it reads as a fragment, not a logo.

purpose: Quiet afterimage: a hairline taper on a smaller radius, covering about 150 degrees with its own small offset cut. Single shape, no concentric repetition.
animationTargets: opacity fade-in
notes: Revision 2. Lavender, intended for the Plum/Graphite world or a mid-tone surface. On Ivory it is intentionally faint (2.24:1).

purpose: Mechanical derivative: seven arcs sharing the primary's interruption angle, alternating offset, one champagne segment beside the cut.
animationTargets: segments index in sequence (per-segment transform, GSAP-owned)
notes: Revision 2. Recoloured from Warm Graphite (1.05:1 on Plum) to Dusty Lavender (5.38:1). Champagne on one segment only.

purpose: Partial editorial frame with four unfinished corner brackets of unequal length, for invitation and composition anchoring.
animationTargets: none; may clip-reveal (T2) on scene entry
notes: Corners are deliberately uneven. Ink only, no fill, so it never covers content.

purpose: Asymmetric portrait framing: four broken edges around an unfilled window so the photograph is never covered.
animationTargets: none; frame may scale with the photo container
notes: Stroke only, window kept clear. Variable aspect: frame is placed by the layout container, not stretched (use preserveAspectRatio default). Does not cover the face when correctly placed.

purpose: Soft-edged compositional cut with one diagonal chamfer, usable as a mask or sectional boundary.
animationTargets: clip-path reveal via GSAP (external geometry reference)
notes: Solid Editorial Mist. Can be referenced as a clipPath in inline use.

purpose: Structural mass with an asymmetric waist: a broad lower-left lobe and a smaller upper-right lobe. Backing surface only.
animationTargets: none; may morph between two states on transitions
notes: REV 3. Waisted two-lobe form instead of a rounded rectangle. Still a single solid fill.

purpose: Horizontal flowing editorial contour for wide compositions and transitions.
animationTargets: stroke-draw left to right
notes: Two half-waves with round caps. Designed as one gesture, not a decorative wave border.

purpose: Complementary flowing form with a different rhythm: two segments with a gap and a butt-capped end. Not a flip of B05.
animationTargets: stroke-draw, segment A then B
notes: Lavender on Ivory is not a text colour (contrast 2.24:1 per DS 3.3). Used as a decorative stroke only.

purpose: Subtle section divider: a thin rule with three descending marks, no ornamental flourish.
animationTargets: none
notes: Deliberately plain. Optimised for letter sections, not for decoration.

purpose: Controlled celebratory arc with one short tick at the terminal, not a rainbow or confetti.
animationTargets: stroke-draw once on reveal
notes: Single arc, single colour.

purpose: Restrained directional burst: five rays over a 120-degree arc with varied lengths. Explicitly not a fireworks or confetti symbol.
animationTargets: rays scale outward in sequence (M1-M3)
notes: Only one half-circle of rays; never a full radial burst.

purpose: Small rhythm of four carefully offset dash marks for a line or a divider in celebration scenes.
animationTargets: dash-offset draw, staggered
notes: Four unequal dashes with varied slopes; readable as rhythm, not a dotted pattern.

purpose: Distinctive micro-accent: an elongated lozenge with one offset arc. Deliberately avoids the four-point sparkle cliche.
animationTargets: none; may pulse once (M1) on a selection
notes: Two colours only. Lozenge is asymmetric in its taper.

purpose: Sculpted single-tier body: a barrel sidewall with a slight outward bulge, a plate with contact shadow, and a right-side crescent shade that follows the body.
animationTargets: none (static); S2 contact handled by parent layer
notes: REV 4. Cylinder sidewall with a slight convex wall, plate with visible edge thickness, base contact crescent, right-hand shade and base occlusion (Mist + Deep Ink only). Ids: d01-body, d01-shade, d01-base-occlusion, d01-plate, d01-cast, d01-contact.

purpose: Frosting mass: a domed top face that overhangs the body, with soft rounded drips (U-lobes, no sharp teeth) and an ivory sheen on the top-left.
animationTargets: fill colour parameterised by the frosting preset
notes: REV 4. Full top-plane ellipse (rx128, ry34, centre 200,136). Skirt hangs from the FRONT RIM arc with seven unequal soft lobes (REV 3 hung periodic lobes from a straight line). Ivory lip highlights (broken) and a soft sheen at 24-40 percent. Frosting colour is the preset.

purpose: Frosting edge shading: ink-only cast shadow on the sponge below the skirt, a thin under-lip tone and a broken shoulder shade. Sits ABOVE D02 and below decorations.
animationTargets: none (static)
notes: REV 4. Replaces the REV 3 piped apricot rope (which read as a garland). Colour-neutral so it stays correct for every frosting preset. Built from the same boundary function as D02 (geom.py).

purpose: Candle body with a left-side highlight stripe and a top cap. Base centre is the anchor (20,120).
animationTargets: none; instance transform set by the store
notes: REV 4. Curved (elliptical) base so the candle sits on the top plane; highlight stripe and wax cap kept. Body colour is a preset (default Periwinkle). Intended composed scale 0.54-0.60 (REV 3 composed at 1.0, far too large).

purpose: Independent flame: outer teardrop plus a champagne core. Separately removable and scale/opacity animatable.
animationTargets: scale, opacity and a subtle sway on the flame group; removed on extinguish
notes: The flame group (d05-root) must be transform-origin at its base so sway does not drift. Extinguish = remove or fade this group only.

purpose: Separate wick so the flame can disappear while the candle body stays visible.
animationTargets: none
notes: Wick sits between flame base and candle top: its bottom (20,20) meets the candle cap.

purpose: Tasteful, abstracted five-petal bloom for the cake surface. Not a cartoon flower.
animationTargets: petals may open on placement (M2 settle)
notes: REV 4. Five irregular rounded outer petals plus five smaller inner petals and a centre. Two colours (outer, inner) are presets. Composed at scale 0.5-0.64 with 0.70 vertical foreshortening so it lies on the top plane.

purpose: Complementary leaf accent: almond shape with a faint midrib. Uses the palette, not literal green.
animationTargets: none
notes: REV 4. Asymmetric curved leaf with a curved rib. Composed at about 0.45-0.5, foreshortened, tucked behind the flower so it reads as attached.

purpose: Restrained topper: an open loop on a short stem. Carries no recipient name; no text is drawn, so personalisation stays in HTML.
animationTargets: none; placed by the store
notes: Do not hardcode a name (DS 9.2, PRD 5.4). Any topper text is HTML overlay with length limits.

purpose: Minimal round decorative detail with a small highlight arc suggesting depth.
animationTargets: none
notes: Two colours (ivory and mist). Depth comes from the mist rim and highlight arc, not a gradient.

purpose: Ribbon band that wraps the sidewall (follows the body ellipse and the silhouette), with a small knot and two short tails. Optional decoration.
animationTargets: none
recommendedSize: compose in the 400x300 cake space at (0,0)
notes: REV 4. REV 3 was a free curved stripe at (100,196) 200x80. Now full cake space: place at 0,0. Band lavender (preset), ink shade 14 percent.

purpose: Subtle smoke path after candles are extinguished. Suitable for stroke-dashoffset draw and fade.
animationTargets: stroke-dashoffset draw then opacity fade (one owner: GSAP)
notes: Ink at 32 percent opacity. Must not be animated continuously; plays once per extinguish.

purpose: Subtle paper-fold accent for the invitation: a folded corner flap with one crease line.
animationTargets: flap may rotate in on Open (M2), with crease line fading
notes: Restrained fold accent, not a stationery clip-art corner.

purpose: Paper sheet silhouette for the S07 letter, with a tonal back-sheet for separation. Text stays in HTML and is not embedded.
animationTargets: none (static reading surface)
notes: Revision 2. Back-sheet adds depth (S1 separation) without a shadow filter. Ivory on Ivory is separated by the Mist edge and the back-sheet.

purpose: Closed tri-fold letter: static base panel (e03-p2), bottom panel folded up (e03-p3, hinge at its bottom edge) and a shorter top flap folded down (e03-p1, hinge at its top edge) so the lower edge shows a stepped stack. No text.
animationTargets: e03-p1 (svgOrigin 120 10) and e03-p3 (svgOrigin 120 114): scaleY 1 to -1; e03-p1-shade / e03-p3-shade: fill-opacity; e03-p1-step and e03-thickness: opacity (GSAP, scene-owned)
notes: REV5. Replaced three identical full-width stacked rectangles with progressively inset panel faces (p1<p2<p3), a curved fold-step wedge, and a top-edge contact shade. Not independently/owner-reviewed.

purpose: Crease overlay for the opened sheet: a straight pressed line with a soft tapered shade. Place one on each hinge line after unfolding.
animationTargets: e04-band as one transform target; e04-edge optional
notes: REV 4. Straight crease (REV 3 was a curved lens). Editorial Mist only.

purpose: Restrained folded-corner detail for a paper edge: sheet corner with a turned flap.
animationTargets: none
notes: A corner accent, not a scrapbook tab.

purpose: Subtle discovery cue for the Quiet Second Invitation: three stepped alignment marks, quietly noticeable, not a call to action.
animationTargets: alignment: each mark may offset by a few units on arm
notes: Must stay quiet: the cue never reads as a button or confession label.

purpose: Incomplete ring for the hidden transition: three arcs with gaps.
animationTargets: arcs may reassemble toward a ring (one owner)
notes: Revision 2. Dusty Lavender on the Deep Plum environment (5.38:1). Intended background: Deep Plum or Warm Graphite, not Ivory.

purpose: 2D segmented mechanical ring: nine segments, one champagne highlight. Reference art for the GLB ring, not a replacement for it.
animationTargets: segments index in sequence (only for the 2D fallback path)
notes: Revision 2. Recoloured from Warm Graphite to Dusty Lavender for Plum contrast. Never presented as the 3D lock.

purpose: Alignment indicators for the Vault: fifteen ticks with one taller champagne centre tick.
animationTargets: centre tick may flash once on lock acknowledgement (M0/M1)
notes: Revision 2. Dusty Lavender ticks on Deep Plum. No numerals.

purpose: Calibration accent: three partial rings on different radii, each with its gap at a different angle, like a mechanism out of alignment.
animationTargets: none (static decoration beside the DOM keypad)
notes: Revision 2. Redesigned to remove the arc-pair look that read as generic. Still no numerals, grid, or dots, so it cannot be mistaken for input.

purpose: Subtle directional cue for a deliberate gesture: a curved track with a start dot. No arrowhead, so it does not read as navigation.
animationTargets: start dot pulses once when the cue is revealed
notes: Not an arrow glyph. Pair with a visible text instruction in HTML (DS 13.2).

purpose: Loop-derived vector mask geometry for a documented transition integration. The file alone does not perform the transition.
animationTargets: clip-path or mask reference driven by GSAP (T2/T4 owner)
notes: Solid shape used as mask data; the fill colour is irrelevant when used as clipPath. Integration must be documented in the usage guide.

purpose: Minimal anchor for a supported gesture: an open ring with a centre target. Not meaningless decoration; marks a drop point.
animationTargets: ring opens on valid placement; target dot marks the anchor
notes: Decorative. Interactive behaviour must come from a real HTML control, not this SVG.
